metadata.description: Comprehensive information about horse coat colors, patterns, and markings

base_colors.name: Bay
base_colors.description: Brown body with black points (mane, tail, lower legs, ear edges)
base_colors.genetics: Genetically a black horse with the agouti gene that restricts black pigment

base_colors.name: Black
base_colors.description: True black coat with no brown areas
base_colors.genetics: Caused by the recessive black gene

base_colors.name: Chestnut
base_colors.description: Reddish-brown coat with no black points, mane and tail same color as body or flaxen
base_colors.genetics: Absence of the black factor, recessive to black

base_colors.name: Gray
base_colors.description: Born dark and progressively lightens with age
base_colors.genetics: Dominant gene that causes progressive depigmentation

base_colors.name: Palomino
base_colors.description: Golden coat with white or flaxen mane and tail
base_colors.genetics: Chestnut base with one cream dilution gene

base_colors.name: Buckskin
base_colors.description: Tan or gold body with black points
base_colors.genetics: Bay base with one cream dilution gene

base_colors.name: Dun
base_colors.description: Tan body with primitive markings (dorsal stripe, leg barring, shoulder stripe)
base_colors.genetics: Caused by the dun dilution gene

base_colors.name: Roan
base_colors.description: Mixture of white hairs with base color, head and legs typically remain solid

base_colors.name: Cream
base_colors.description: Creamy coat with pink skin and blue eyes
base_colors.genetics: Double cream dilution gene on any base color

patterns.name: Tobiano
patterns.description: White crossing the topline, legs usually white, head usually solid
characteristics: White crossing the back between withers and tail

patterns.name: Overo
patterns.description: White does not usually cross the topline, jagged edges to markings
patterns.genetics: Several different genetic patterns including frame, splash, and sabino
characteristics: White usually does not cross the back

patterns.name: Appaloosa
patterns.description: Spotted pattern with several variable characteristics

patterns.name: Brindle
patterns.genetics: Rare pattern, genetic basis not fully understood
characteristics: Can appear in various base colors

face_markings.name: Stripe
face_markings.description: Narrow white marking running down the face

face_markings.name: Blaze
face_markings.description: Wide white marking running down the face

face_markings.name: Bald Face
face_markings.description: White face that extends beyond the eyes and to the sides

leg_markings.name: Pastern
leg_markings.description: White extending from hoof to pastern

leg_markings.name: Sock
leg_markings.description: White extending from hoof to ankle

leg_markings.name: Stocking
leg_markings.description: White extending from hoof to knee or hock

body_markings.name: Dorsal Stripe
body_markings.description: Dark line running along the spine

rare_colors.name: Silver Dapple
rare_colors.description: Dilutes black pigment in mane, tail and body, often with dappling
rare_colors.genetics: Silver dapple gene affects black pigment only

rare_colors.name: Champagne
rare_colors.description: Dilutes both red and black pigment, creates metallic sheen and mottled skin

rare_colors.name: Pearl
rare_colors.description: Subtle dilution that enhances red pigment, double effect when paired with cream gene

color_combinations.name: Bay Tobiano
color_combinations.description: Bay base coat with tobiano pattern

color_combinations.name: Palomino with Flaxen
color_combinations.description: Golden coat with very light, almost white mane and tail

color_combinations.name: Blue Roan Appaloosa
color_combinations.description: Blue roan base with appaloosa spotting pattern
